source_row.extraction_instructions: Listing comes from one JSON endpoint, /api/events/currentevents, returning every calendar event (no pagination); list_shells_override reads it. Detail pages /master-calendar/<slug> are server-rendered (mcEvent-* classes) but publish no fees; pricing_tiers is []. Locations are usually just a US state. Events more than 24 months out are skipped.

registry_comment: 59: ACEP — American College of Emergency Physicians event calendar (JSON API listing, USD, no fees published)

spot_check.extractor_says: 2026-10-30 to 2026-11-02; city La Paz, region Mexico; 45.0

concerns: ACEP publishes no fees on its pages (registration is on organiser sites), so pricing_tiers is [] for every event.
Venue is rarely published: most US events give only a state (e.g. ACEP26 Scientific Assembly shows just 'Illinois'); city stays None rather than guessed.

The API answers XML unless Accept: application/json is sent; extractor sends that header and falls back to the Playwright context request API (Chromium's XML viewer breaks fetch_html on the browser path). Both paths give 47 shells.
booking_url is set to the organiser's own link when one is valid, else the ACEP page; source_url stays the ACEP page for dedupe.
Events starting more than 24 months out (ACEP29-32 placeholders) are skipped; ended events are skipped. 54 API rows -> 47 shells.
ACEP types everything Conference/Webinar; event_type is derived from the title (course/workshop/conference), a heuristic.
Webinars are included as event_type workshop with event_format online; drop them if on-demand/webinars are out of scope.
One LLM 429 seen during the forced-fallback run; the deterministic description/specialty backstop covered it.
